relationships.description: The contact identifies the person or team accountable for maintaining the API contract described by the OpenAPI document, giving consumers of that document a named point of escalation for questions about its paths and behaviour.
relationships.evidence: The OpenAPI file (openapi.yaml/json, or the generated spec endpoint) contains an info.contact object whose name, email or url fields populate this contact for that specific document.

notes: Contact is structurally nested in the Info object, which the document composes, so associated-with to OpenAPIDocument is an indirect shortcut. A composes/aggregated-by relationship with api.info would express the containment more precisely. This document-level link may then be redundant.
